name: teach
title_zh: 在对话里直接练成一项新技能，不换窗口
tagline_zh: 不用切到教程网站、不用开视频。你问它答、它出题你练，练完当场能上手。适合学软件操作、写作套路。
tagline_en: No tabs, no videos. It teaches by Q&A and hands-on drills, so you can actually do the thing by the time you close.
desc_en: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.
why_zh: 它把教学拆成「讲一步、练一步、纠一步」的闭环，而不是丢给你一篇长文。你卡在哪它就从哪续上。
why_en: It breaks teaching into a tight loop—explain, practice, correct—instead of dumping a wall of text. Stuck? It picks up right.
limit_zh: 只教「能在这个工作区里演示或练习」的技能。抽象理论、需要外部账号或真实设备的操作，它教不了，只能给概念概述。
limit_en: Only teaches skills demonstrable or drivable inside this workspace. Abstract theory or anything needing external accounts/real hardware gets only a.
title_en: Learn a new skill right inside this chat
